_doc: The inputs of tools/seaslug_lit.py (the sea-slug literature watch; docs/reviews/2026-11-17-seaslug-literature-scan.md). Hand-kept: the tool reads this file and never writes it. since: the first year of the authorities counted as new (the 2nd edition of the regional guide, Gosliner, Valdes & Behrens, is 2018; Pierre, 2026-11-17: the guide is dated and not used). ignoreSources: WoRMS sources left out of the 'revised' list (the start of the reference, and why). extraGenera: genera outside tools/seaslugs.json that are watched too, each with why. labels: the informal 'sp. N' labels with 4 or more unhedged observers in the Philippines (docs/reviews/2026-11-17-seaslug-undescribed-species-study.md, Appendix A), as observers write them, with those observers; a label with no `named` entry stays in the tool's 'unnamed' list. named: an informal label (NSSI2 = Gosliner, Valdes & Behrens 2018) or an old broad name that a paper now names: the name, the paper (rule C2) and how the link is known (the note's labels: [read] a page, [measured] counted on iNaturalist); the tool checks the name in WoRMS and its presence (rule C8).

ignoreSources.ref: Gosliner, T. et al. (2023). Southern African Sea Slugs.
ignoreSources.why: A regional field guide (South Africa) that WoRMS lists as an additional source on most of our species: not a revision.

extraGenera.Eubranchus: Three informal labels with 4 or more observers (sp. 10, 23, 28); no species confirmed in the Philippines yet (undescribed study, Appendix A).
extraGenera.Aldisa: Aldisa sp. 9, 4 observers (undescribed study, Appendix A).
extraGenera.Facelina: Facelina sp. 9, 4 observers (undescribed study, Appendix A).
